notes.title: RAT MEMORY March and April Development News
notes.content:
Hi, today we have your [strike]monthly[/strike] bimonthly update about the development of RAT MEMORY!
I'm preparing and bug fixing the game for the full release, coming in a few months hopefully.

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Launched the new demo update!
[*] Improved player visibility by adding lights above and below the character.
[*] New fur.
[/list]

[h2]FIXES [i][strike](Sorry speedrunners)[/strike][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed many glitches such as collecting the same item as many times you want;
and breaking cardboxes in day level before the player unlocked jumping or interaction (reseting the level makes the character respawn with a falling animation - this animation sends a signal to break cardboxes close to the player)
[*] Fixed character sliding after jumping into a cardboard.
[*] Fixed anything activating the reset player position trigger.
[/list]

[h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]ADDED SKINS[/b]
[*] The general day level layout. As you may know, the story unfolds in this day level. This level is planned to be the same each time you visit it, but with minor differences (like being able to jump, or more obstacles).
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates, and I see you in June! Hopefully with a launch date!

Please follow Quero Games on [url=https://twitter.com/querogames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfMzFdiw4-dfsLe3gkWiVTQ/]Youtube[/url].

New fur.

Fixed character sliding after jumping into a cardboard.
Fixed anything activating the reset player position trigger.

notes.title: RAT MEMORY December and January Development News
notes.content:
Hi, today we have your monthly update about the development of RAT MEMORY!
In this case two months of development.

First of all, you can play the new update to the demo this week!

Now what I'm doing:
[h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] Starting to working in the day level. The day level will be the same for each day, just with some small differences each time.
[*] Collectibles! In the full game you will be able to collect coins and unlock upgrades and customizations that contribute to progress the game.
[*] [strike][i]There is also another collectible that will do something that I can't say for now.[/i][/strike]
[/list]


[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completed many night levels (I think all of them?)
[*] I'm starting to working in the game progress, so you will be able to play all the levels in order and enjoy the story. And also start and finish the game.
[*] I probably changed some more things that I can't remember now.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates, and I see you in March!

Please follow Quero Games on [url=https://twitter.com/querogames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfMzFdiw4-dfsLe3gkWiVTQ/]Youtube[/url].

notes.title: Demo update 2.0 September 6 2022
notes.content:
[i]First of all, sorry for the delay. I promised this update would be available in late August, but a critical bug prevented me to launch it. Now that the bug is fixed, I can publish it. Have fun![/i]

This update for RAT MEMORY DEMO brings many improvements and some content!

[b]NEW:[/b]
[h2]A new level![/h2]
This is a exploration level - find the coins in this not so colorful level to unlock the star.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42467984/9d5722e3df0fae1bbe713de33bc88e8601ad03cd.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added level selection menu in main menu.
[*] Added button to reset camera view.
[*] Added full gamepad support to menus.
[*] You can close menus with your pause button.
[*] Added some settings, like sensitivity of camera, ability to invert the camera controls, gamma correction and audio volume.
[*] Added checkpoints in old level.
[*] Added Quero Games logo in credits.
[/list]

[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] I changed the jump slightly - you should be able to reach the same height, but maybe at a lower speed [i]Thanks for the feedback people![/i].
[*] The change above also fix the character staying forever in air when stuck in a border.
[*] Moved easter-egg in old level to a better position.
[*] Moved player starting point in old level to a better position.
[*] Changed color of default controls screen.
[*] Game size is lower - about 600 MB instead of 1.94GB.
[/list]

[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Camera has a different position. [i]Thanks for the feedback people![/i]
[*] Changed some visuals in old level. [i]Thanks for the feedback people![/i]
[*] Fix for a bug pressing ESC in main menu.
[/list]

[i]Please note that some texts aren't translated in all languages, and I'm sorry for this.[/i]

You can win the full game by playing this level! Details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1953100/view/3328744607317009389]here[/url]
